sources.source_name: CMU MLIP Data Quality — Inventory Management Case Study
sources.transformation_notes: Verified HTTP 200 (60 clean / 64 dirty products, 12/13 suppliers, 198,421 clean deliveries, 5,824 dirty_errors rows, 2024-01-01..2025-12-31). GitHub repository metadata has license=null and no LICENSE file; therefore zero rows or files were copied. Adopted conceptual failure taxonomy: duplicate deliveries, received_at vs entered_at lag, stock count discrepancy, and illegal units (kg vs lbs/KG).

sources.source_name: Badan Pangan Nasional — Publikasi Stok & Rata-rata Harga Pangan (SAPA)
sources.transformation_notes: Verified HTTP 200 metadata page stating 'Dataset Terbatas — Informasi lengkap dan data lengkap hanya tersedia pada S.A.P.A (https://sapa.badanpangan.go.id/)'. Unit Ton (national monthly stock) and Rp/kg (provincial consumer/producer monthly average). Not scraped; supported via manual authorized reference CSV import kept strictly separate from kitchen stock.

sources.transformation_notes: Verified Angular SPA with Google reCAPTCHA protection. Per policy, no automated scraping or CAPTCHA bypass implemented. Authorized exports must be imported manually via market-reference CSV template.
